name: NPS International School
summary: Indian curriculum international school with a strong academics reputation.
body: NPS International is frequently compared within the Indian-curriculum international segment for academic rigour. Confirm current campus, board offerings, and co-curricular breadth during tours — fit varies by child profile. Ask on tour how sports day / carnival volunteer shifts are scheduled for dual-career households, and how outbreak or HFMD letters are communicated to working parents. Smaller campus calendars still run exclusion letters hard — fifth-disease weeks need the same written return clock discipline as larger international schools.
